label: Heuristic, not a validated model. Hand-written rules mapping detected tools to Cholec80 phases for a demo label. Thresholds are untuned guesses; tune on Cholec80 tool and phase annotations before relying on them.
basis: Tool usage correlates with surgical phase in Cholec80: Twinanda AP, Shehata S, Mutter D, Marescaux J, de Mathelin M, Padoy N. EndoNet: A Deep Architecture for Recognition Tasks on Laparoscopic Videos. arXiv:1602.03012 (2016), which notes that tool signals provide valuable information for phase recognition. Journal version: IEEE Trans Med Imaging 2017;36(1):86-97 (volume/pages not verified).
dataset: Cholec80, CAMMA (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). Phase labels at 25 fps, tool-presence labels at 1 fps.
typical_tools_note: typical_tools are a qualitative summary, not counts from the annotations.

evaluation.presence: A tool counts as present in a 1-s step if any detection of it has confidence >= 0.5 in that second.
evaluation.fraction: f(tool) = seconds present in the last window_s / window_s

hysteresis.confirm_note: A candidate transition must be true for 3 consecutive steps before the phase changes.
hysteresis.min_dwell_note: No transition out of a phase until it has been held this long.
hysteresis.exit_lower_than_enter: Enter thresholds (below) are higher than the 'absent' conditions used to leave a phase, so the label does not flicker.
hysteresis.detector_unavailable: Hold the current phase and show it as stale; never guess.

allowed_transitions_note: Mostly the canonical order P1..P7. The backtrack P3->P2 and the P6/P7 swaps are allowed because cases vary; check the graph against the Cholec80 phase annotations.

rules.when: Clipper and Scissors absent for >= 20 s and f(Hook) >= 0.5 and Scissors seen at least once in this phase
Clipper and Scissors absent for >= 20 s and f(Hook) >= 0.5 and Scissors never seen in this phase
f(SpecimenBag) >= 0.3 and Irrigator and Bipolar absent for >= 10 s
dwell in GallbladderPackaging >= 60 s and SpecimenBag absent for >= 10 s, then f(SpecimenBag) >= 0.3 again

rule_order: Evaluate only rules whose 'from' is the current phase, in list order; first match becomes the candidate.

out_of_phase_events.when: f(Irrigator) >= 0.3 while phase is CalotTriangleDissection, ClippingCutting or GallbladderDissection
out_of_phase_events.event: Suction/irrigator in use outside cleaning phase
out_of_phase_events.note: Passed to the surgical agent as an observation. Can mean bleeding, smoke or fluid; it is not a bleeding detector. Does not change the phase.

out_of_phase_events.when: f(Bipolar) >= 0.2 while phase is ClippingCutting or GallbladderDissection
out_of_phase_events.event: Bipolar in use outside cleaning phase
out_of_phase_events.note: Observation only; does not change the phase.

presenter_override: The /control page can force a phase if the heuristic is wrong during the demo; the label then reads 'set by presenter'.
